name: Love's Gift
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.

Leave me, adventurer. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.

And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, adventurer. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?
